notes.title: Version 0.6 Incoming
notes.notes:
Major update will drop soon including 2 new levels, unlockable content, and the ability to save your trip mid session. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/e267dbd5ebb53a851e4266b7ae56a2ccc99b3f94.png
The first new stage > takes place deep in the outer reaches of the universe, somewhere near Uranus. > revolves around tunnels and washing machines or something, who knows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42386728/968682a01f81e0867630ae99aa019752cc2c1384.png
The currents levels have been overhauled with higher fidelity textures and extra paths to show off these new trippy elements.  Wordphrases have been localized into 4 additional languages, and you'll now be able to earn psychedelic rewards for finishing the trips.
